    55  /**
    56   * This class implements Network Layer TLV generation and parsing.
    57   *
    58   */
    59  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
    60  class ThreadTlv : public ot::Tlv
    61  {
    62  public:
    63      /**
    64       * Network Layer TLV Types.
    65       *
    66       */
    67      enum Type
    68      {
    69          kTarget              = 0,  ///< Target EID TLV
    70          kExtMacAddress       = 1,  ///< Extended MAC Address TLV
    71          kRloc16              = 2,  ///< RLOC16 TLV
    72          kMeshLocalEid        = 3,  ///< ML-EID TLV
    73          kStatus              = 4,  ///< Status TLV
    74          kLastTransactionTime = 6,  ///< Time Since Last Transaction TLV
    75          kRouterMask          = 7,  ///< Router Mask TLV
    76          kNDOption            = 8,  ///< ND Option TLV
    77          kNDData              = 9,  ///< ND Data TLV
    78          kThreadNetworkData   = 10, ///< Thread Network Data TLV
    79      };
    80
    81      /**
    82       * This method returns the Type value.
    83       *
    84       * @returns The Type value.
    85       *
    86       */
    87      Type GetType(void) const { return static_cast<Type>(ot::Tlv::GetType()); }
    88
    89      /**
    90       * This method sets the Type value.
    91       *
    92       * @param[in]  aType  The Type value.
    93       *
    94       */
    95      void SetType(Type aType) { ot::Tlv::SetType(static_cast<uint8_t>(aType)); }
    96
    97      /**
    98       * This static method reads the requested TLV out of @p aMessage.
    99       *
   100       * @param[in]   aMessage    A reference to the message.
   101       * @param[in]   aType       The Type value to search for.
   102       * @param[in]   aMaxLength  Maximum number of bytes to read.
   103       * @param[out]  aTlv        A reference to the TLV that will be copied to.
   104       *
   105       * @retval OT_ERROR_NONE       Successfully copied the TLV.
   106       * @retval OT_ERROR_NOT_FOUND  Could not find the TLV with Type @p aType.
   107       *
   108       */
   109      static otError GetTlv(const Message &aMessage, Type aType, uint16_t aMaxLength, Tlv &aTlv)
   110      {
   111          return ot::Tlv::Get(aMessage, static_cast<uint8_t>(aType), aMaxLength, aTlv);
   112      }
   113
   114  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   257  /**
   258   * This class implements ML-EID TLV generation and parsing.
   259   *
   260   */
   261  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
   262  class ThreadMeshLocalEidTlv : public ThreadTlv
   263  {
   264  public:
   265      /**
   266       * This method initializes the TLV.
   267       *
   268       */
   269      void Init(void)
   270      {
   271          SetType(kMeshLocalEid);
   272          SetLength(sizeof(*this) - sizeof(ThreadTlv));
   273      }
   274
   275      /**
   276       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   277       *
   278       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   279       * @retval FALSE  If the TLV does not appear to be well-formed.
   280       *
   281       */
   282      bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(ThreadTlv); }
   283
   284      /**
   285       * This method returns a pointer to the ML-EID IID.
   286       *
   287       * @returns A pointer to the Extended MAC Address.
   288       *
   289       */
   290      const uint8_t *GetIid(void) const { return mIid; }
   291
   292      /**
   293       * This method sets the ML-EID IID.
   294       *
   295       * @param[in]  aIid  A pointer to the ML-EID IID.
   296       *
   297       */
   298      void SetIid(const uint8_t *aIid) { memcpy(mIid, aIid, sizeof(mIid)); }
   299
   300      /**
   301       * This method sets the ML-EID IID.
   302       *
   303       * @param[in]  aExtAddress  A reference to the MAC Extended Address.
   304       *
   305       */
   306      void SetIid(const Mac::ExtAddress &aExtAddress)
   307      {
   308          memcpy(mIid, aExtAddress.m8, sizeof(mIid));
   309          mIid[0] ^= 0x2;
   310      }
   311
   312  private:
   313      uint8_t mIid[8];
   314  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   427  class ThreadRouterMaskTlv : public ThreadTlv
   428  {
   429  public:
   430      /**
   431       * This method initializes the TLV.

   433       */
   434      void Init(void)
   435      {
   436          SetType(kRouterMask);

   441       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   442       *
   443       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.

   446       */
   447      bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(ThreadTlv); }

   449      /**
   450       * This method returns the ID Sequence value.
   451       *
   452       * @returns The ID Sequence value.
   453       *
   454       */
   455      uint8_t GetIdSequence(void) const { return mIdSequence; }
   456
   457      /**
   458       * This method sets the ID Sequence value.
   459       *
   460       * @param[in]  aSequence  The ID Sequence value.
   461       *
   462       */
   463      void SetIdSequence(uint8_t aSequence) { mIdSequence = aSequence; }
   464
   465      /**
   466       * This method clears the Assigned Router ID Mask.
   467       *
   468       */
   469      void ClearAssignedRouterIdMask(void) { memset(mAssignedRouterIdMask, 0, sizeof(mAssignedRouterIdMask)); }
   470
   471      /**
   472       * This method indicates whether or not a given Router ID is set in the Assigned Router ID Mask.
   473       *
   474       * @param[in]  aRouterId  The Router ID.
   475       *
   476       * @retval TRUE   If the given Router ID is set in the Assigned Router ID Mask.
   477       * @retval FALSE  If the given Router ID is not set in the Assigned Router ID Mask.
   478       *
   479       */
   480      bool IsAssignedRouterIdSet(uint8_t aRouterId) const
   481      {
   482          return (mAssignedRouterIdMask[aRouterId / 8] & (0x80 >> (aRouterId % 8))) != 0;
   483      }
   484
   485      /**
   486       * This method clears the Assigned Router ID Mask.
   487       *
   488       * @param[in]  aRouterId  The Router ID.
   489       *
   490       */
   491      void SetAssignedRouterId(uint8_t aRouterId) { mAssignedRouterIdMask[aRouterId / 8] |= 0x80 >> (aRouterId % 8); }
   492
   493  private:
   494      uint8_t mIdSequence;
   495      uint8_t mAssignedRouterIdMask[BitVectorBytes(Mle::kMaxRouterId + 1)];
   496  };
